blocks.why: CAN prints LN 2 but the block is 'Zadanie 3 – Komputer przenośny' and its estimate 2,845.53 PLN is CN LOT-3's VALUE exactly; sequential LN puts it on LOT-2 instead of LOT-3 (ratio vs LOT-2 0.95 is a coincidence). One lot, wrong lot.
